library(tidyverse)

## Question 8

```{r}
set.seed(208)
B = 100000
u1 = runif(B)
u2 = runif(B)
u3 = runif(B)
```

#### Part B

Y ~ N(50,8^2)

```{r}
y = 50 + 8 * qnorm(u1)

print(c(mean(y), var(y)))
```

D ~ Bernoulli(0.30)

```{r}
p = 0.30

d = as.integer(u2 > 1 - p)

print(c(mean(d), var(d)))
```

X(Q4)

```{r}
x = u3^(1/3)

print(c(mean(x), var(x)))
```

Estimations:

```{r}
print(mean(y > 58))

print(mean(d == 1))

print(mean(x <= 0.5))
```

#### Part C

```{r}
hist(y, freq = FALSE, ylim = c(0, 0.055))

curve(dnorm(x, 50, 8), add = TRUE)
```

```{r}
hist(x, freq = FALSE, ylim = c(0, 3.5))

curve(3 * x^2, from = 0, to = 1, add = TRUE)
```

#### Part D

```{r}
print(sort(unique(pbinom(d, 1, p))))
```
